# DO NOT EDIT THIS FILE! THIS FILE IS AUTOMATICALLY GENERATED BY xml2cmake
CMAKE_MINIMUM_REQUIRED(VERSION 3.18 FATAL_ERROR)

# Ensure installs stay under ~/.visit unless caller overrides the prefix.
if(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX_INITIALIZED_TO_DEFAULT)
    set(CMAKE_INSTALL_PREFIX "$ENV{HOME}/.visit" CACHE PATH
        "Default install prefix for user-local VisIt plugins." FORCE)
endif()

SET(VISIT_PLUGIN_DIR "$ENV{HOME}/.visit/3.4.2/linux-x86_64/plugins" CACHE PATH
    "Directory where VisIt installs database plugins.")
SET(VISIT_PLUGIN_VS_INSTALL_FILE "/sw/andes/visit/3.4.2/linux-x86_64/include/PluginVsInstall.cmake"
    CACHE FILEPATH "Path to PluginVsInstall.cmake from the VisIt installation.")
SET(VISIT_LIBRARY_DEPENDENCIES_FILE "${CMAKE_CURRENT_LIST_DIR}/VisItLibraryDependencies.cmake"
    CACHE FILEPATH "Path to VisIt's library dependency list for this plugin.")
INCLUDE("${VISIT_PLUGIN_VS_INSTALL_FILE}")
INCLUDE("${VISIT_LIBRARY_DEPENDENCIES_FILE}")

PROJECT(amrex_database)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD 17)
set(CMAKE_CXX_STANDARD_REQUIRED ON)
set(CMAKE_CXX_EXTENSIONS OFF)

include(FetchContent)

option(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE
       "Skip building/caching structured boundary metadata for ghost synthesis"
       OFF)
if(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE)
    add_compile_definitions(AMREX_DISABLE_STRUCTURED_BOUNDARY_CACHE)
endif()

SET(COMMON_SOURCES
amrexPluginInfo.C
amrexCommonPluginInfo.C
)

SET(LIBI_SOURCES
amrexPluginInfo.C
)

SET(LIBM_SOURCES
amrexMDServerPluginInfo.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
avtamrexFileFormat.C
)

SET(LIBE_SOURCES
amrexEnginePluginInfo.C
${COMMON_SOURCES}
avtamrexFileFormat.C
)

INCLUDE_DIRECTORIES(
${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}
${VISIT_DATABASE_INCLUDES}
)

LINK_DIRECTORIES(${VISIT_LIBRARY_DIR})

# AMReX superbuild
set(AMREX_GIT_TAG "24.05" CACHE STRING "AMReX git tag to fetch")
set(AMReX_BUILD_SHARED_LIBS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_FORTRAN OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_EB OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_LINEAR_SOLVERS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_PARTICLES OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_FFT OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(AMReX_SPACEDIM 3 CACHE STRING "" FORCE)
FetchContent_Declare(
    amrex
    GIT_REPOSITORY https://github.com/AMReX-Codes/amrex.git
    GIT_TAG ${AMREX_GIT_TAG}
    GIT_SHALLOW TRUE
)
FetchContent_MakeAvailable(amrex)

set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TESTING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_TOOLS OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_BENCHMARKING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_BUILD_SHARED OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_LIBDWARF OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_USE_EXTERNAL_LIBDWARF OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_USE_EXTERNAL_ZSTD OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_ADDR2LINE ON CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
set(CPPTRACE_GET_SYMBOLS_WITH_NOTHING OFF CACHE BOOL "" FORCE)
add_subdirectory(${amrex_database_SOURCE_DIR}/extern/cpptrace ${amrex_database_BINARY_DIR}/cpptrace)

ADD_LIBRARY(IamrexDatabase ${LIBI_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(IamrexDatabase visitcommon AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS IamrexDatabase)

IF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)
    ADD_LIBRARY(MamrexDatabase ${LIBM_SOURCES})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(MamrexDatabase visitcommon avtdbatts avtdatabase_ser AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(MamrexDatabase MDSERVER)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} MamrexDatabase)
ENDIF(NOT VISIT_ENGINE_ONLY AND NOT VISIT_DBIO_ONLY)

ADD_LIBRARY(EamrexDatabase_ser ${LIBE_SOURCES})
TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EamrexDatabase_ser visitcommon avtpipeline_ser avtdatabase_ser AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EamrexDatabase_ser ENGINE)
SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EamrexDatabase_ser)

IF(VISIT_PARALLEL)
    ADD_PARALLEL_LIBRARY(EamrexDatabase_par ${LIBE_SOURCES})
    TARGET_LINK_LIBRARIES(EamrexDatabase_par visitcommon avtpipeline_par avtdatabase_par AMReX::amrex cpptrace::cpptrace)
    ADD_TARGET_DEFINITIONS(EamrexDatabase_par ENGINE)
    SET(INSTALLTARGETS ${INSTALLTARGETS} EamrexDatabase_par)
ENDIF(VISIT_PARALLEL)

VISIT_INSTALL_DATABASE_PLUGINS(${INSTALLTARGETS})
